# About Precision Roofing Alabama

Alabama's trusted, licensed & insured roofing contractor for replacements, repairs, and storm-damage insurance claims. Built on honesty, quality, and a commitment to protecting your home.

Who Are We?

### Alabama's Trusted Roofing Contractor

At Precision Roofing Alabama, we're a locally owned and operated roofing company proudly serving homeowners across the entire State of Alabama. We specialize in roof replacements, repairs, and storm-damage restoration, delivering dependable solutions that protect, restore, and strengthen homes of every size.

Whether it's a full architectural-shingle replacement, a stubborn leak, or hail and severe-storm damage, our crews are committed to quality craftsmanship and professional execution. We use premium, manufacturer-spec materials, proven installation methods, and maintain clear communication from start to finish.

For homeowners, we focus on protecting your investment and your peace of mind, handling insurance claims directly with your adjuster so the process stays smooth, fair, and stress-free from inspection to final nail.

At Precision Roofing Alabama, integrity, attention to detail, and doing the job right the first time aren't just promises. They're our standard.

Proud installer of CertainTeed roofing products.

**Honest Communication**

No surprises. No hidden costs. We provide clear estimates, detailed scopes of work, and keep you informed from start to finish.

**Free, No-Pressure Inspections**

Complimentary roof inspections with honest findings and clear photos, so you know exactly what your roof needs and what it doesn't.

**Financing Options Available**

Flexible financing for all budgets so a new roof can fit your finances. Ask about current plans and terms during your free estimate.

**We Treat Your Home Like Our Own**

Clean job sites, respectful crews, protected landscaping, and attention to detail, because your home deserves the very best.

He loves being his own boss because it lets him build a business that goes above and beyond for its clients, its employees, and its community. In practice that means crews that show up when they said they would, details that do not get skipped, and a homeowner who gets a straight answer even when the answer is that the roof can wait.

FAQ

### About Our Company, Answered

Q: Who owns Precision Roofing Alabama?
A:
Precision Roofing Alabama LLC is locally owned and operated by two co-owners, Cary Dean and Will Thornton. Every job runs through both of them, from the first free inspection to the final walkthrough. Cary typically handles inspections and works directly with insurance adjusters, and Will brings over 7 years of hands-on construction experience to overseeing crews and job quality.

Q: Is Precision Roofing Alabama licensed and insured?
A:
Yes. We hold Alabama Home Builder license HB # 41012 and carry full liability and workers compensation coverage. We are also a CertainTeed certified contractor. We are glad to provide proof of license and insurance before any work begins, and you should ask any roofer for the same.

Q: How long has Precision Roofing Alabama been in business?
A:
Our team brings over 10 years of roofing experience and we have completed more than 100 roofs across Alabama. We hold a 5.0 star rating from our Google reviews, and most of our work comes from homeowners who were referred by a neighbor we already took care of.

Q: What roofing brands and materials do you install?
A:
We are a CertainTeed certified contractor and install CertainTeed products, including premium architectural shingles selected to hold up to Alabama heat, humidity, and severe storms. Everything goes on to manufacturer spec, which is what keeps your material warranty intact.

Q: What makes you different from other Alabama roofers?
A:
Two things folks tell us most often. First, we will talk you out of work you do not need. If a repair solves the problem, we quote the repair rather than push a replacement . Second, we handle the insurance claim ourselves, including meeting your adjuster on the roof, so you are not stuck translating between a contractor and a carrier.

Q: Do you use your own crews or subcontractors?
A:
Our crews are our own people, and both owners are on the jobs. Will has personally done every task he asks a crew to do. That is how we keep clean job sites, protected landscaping, and details that do not get skipped, because the folks doing the work answer directly to the folks who own the company.

# Roof Replacement in Alabama, Done in a Day

When repairs aren't enough, Precision Roofing Alabama delivers a full tear-off and rebuild: premium materials and expert installation built to protect your home for decades.

### A New Roof, Built to Last

Your roof is the single most important protective system on your home. When age, storm damage, or years of Alabama heat have taken their toll, a full replacement is the smartest long-term investment you can make.

Every replacement is a complete tear-off and rebuild done to manufacturer spec . As a CertainTeed-certified installer , we build with premium architectural shingles, proper underlayment and ventilation, and meticulous flashing details that keep water out for the long haul.

We replace roofs across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn-Opelika, and Baldwin County , with most homes finished in a single day, your landscaping protected, and the site left spotless.

Get a Free Estimate
(334) 318-7255

What's Included

### A Complete Roof System, Not Just Shingles

Full tear-off. We strip every old layer down to the decking. No shortcuts, and no "roof-overs" that trap heat and hide rot.

Decking inspection and repair. Once the roof is open, we check every sheet of decking and replace anything soft or water-damaged, so your new roof sits on a solid foundation.

Underlayment, ice & water barriers, and ventilation. The parts you never see are what make a roof last in Alabama heat and humidity: synthetic underlayment, sealed valleys and penetrations, and balanced attic ventilation that protects your shingles and your energy bill.

CertainTeed architectural shingles. Premium shingles engineered for southern weather, installed to the manufacturer's exact spec, which is what keeps your material warranty good.

Cleanup and walkthrough. Magnetic nail sweep of your yard and driveway, hauled-off debris, and a final walkthrough with photos of the finished roof.

How It Works

### From Inspection to Installed, Usually in One Day

**Free Inspection**

We assess the whole roof, photograph everything, and tell you honestly whether you need a replacement or just a repair .

**Clear Written Estimate**

Itemized pricing, shingle and color choices, and financing options , all decided before any work begins.

**Build Day**

Our crew tears off, rebuilds, and installs to spec. Most homes are finished in a single day.

**Walkthrough & Warranty**

Final inspection together, full photo documentation, and your warranty paperwork in hand.

Pricing

### What Does a New Roof Cost in Alabama?

Every roof is different, but the price comes down to four things: size and pitch of the roof, the shingle line you choose, how many layers have to come off, and the condition of the decking underneath. We give you an itemized written estimate up front. The number we quote is the number you pay unless we find hidden damage, and if we do, we photograph it and talk it through with you before touching a thing.

Two ways to make it easier: if your roof failed from storm or hail damage , your insurance may owe you a roof, and we handle that claim process for you. And for every roof, flexible financing can turn a big year into a manageable monthly payment.

FAQ

### Roof Replacement Questions, Answered

Q: How long does a roof replacement take?
A:
Most Alabama homes are completed in a single day. Larger or more complex roofs may take two, and we give you a clear, realistic timeline before we ever start.

Q: What affects the cost of a roof replacement in Alabama?
A:
Roof size and pitch, the shingle line you choose, how many layers need tearing off, and whether any decking needs replacing once we open it up. Every estimate is free, written, and itemized, so there are no surprises on build day.

Q: Do you offer financing for a new roof?
A:
Yes. Flexible financing options are available so a needed roof doesn't have to wait on a lump sum. Ask during your free inspection and we'll walk you through the choices.

Q: Will insurance pay for my roof replacement?
A:
If the roof failed from sudden storm or hail damage, your homeowners policy likely covers it, and we handle the entire claim process for you. If the roof is simply worn out from age, that's typically not covered, and we'll give you honest numbers and financing options instead.

# Roof Repair in Alabama, Done Right the First Time

Leaks, missing shingles, storm damage. Precision Roofing Alabama finds the real problem and fixes it right, protecting your home before small issues turn into expensive ones.

### Repairs Done Right, the First Time

Not every roofing problem calls for a full replacement. A fast, expert repair can stop a leak, restore protection, and add years to the life of your existing roof, for a fraction of the cost.

Our crews track down the real source of the problem, not just the symptom, and fix it to manufacturer spec . We take care of homeowners across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn-Opelika, and Baldwin County , and we're licensed, insured, and 5.0-star rated by folks right here in Alabama.

We document everything with clear photos, explain exactly what we found in plain English, and leave your roof watertight and your property spotless.

Get a Free Inspection
(334) 318-7255

What We Fix

### The Repairs Alabama Roofs Need Most

Roof leaks. Water stains on a ceiling rarely sit right under the hole. We trace the water back to where it actually got in, whether that's a cracked pipe boot, failed sealant, or a lifted shingle, and we fix the source, not the symptom.

Missing or damaged shingles. Alabama wind and summer storms lift, crease, and tear shingles. We match your existing shingle as closely as we can and secure the courses around it so the same spot doesn't give you trouble again.

Flashing, valleys, and chimneys. Most "mystery leaks" start where the roof meets something else: chimneys, walls, skylights, and valleys. We reset or replace flashing the way the manufacturer intended, instead of smearing on caulk that gives out in a season.

Storm and hail damage. After a storm rolls through, damage can be spread out and hard to spot from the ground. If it's isolated, we repair it and you're done. If it's widespread, you may have an insurance claim on your hands. Take a look at our storm & hail damage page, and rest easy knowing we handle the claim process for you.

How It Works

### Our Repair Process

If a repair solves it, that's what we quote. You get a clear written estimate before any work starts.

Materials matched to your roof, installed to manufacturer spec by our own experienced crew.

**Proof & Cleanup**

Pricing

### What Does Roof Repair Cost in Alabama?

Repair pricing comes down to a few things: the size of the damaged area , the pitch and height of your roof, the materials needed to match what's there, and whether the decking underneath took on water. A simple shingle repair costs a small fraction of a replacement. Repairs that get into decking or a lot of flashing work cost more, and we'll tell you why before we touch a thing.

Here's our promise to you: the inspection is free , the estimate is written and transparent , and we won't talk you into a replacement you don't need. If your roof is getting close to the end of its life, we'll sit down and show you honest numbers for both options, financing included, and let you make the call. That's how we'd want to be treated, so that's how we do business.

FAQ

### Roof Repair Questions, Answered

Q: How much does roof repair cost in Alabama?
A:
Most common repairs, like replacing missing shingles, resealing flashing, or patching a small leak, cost far less than a replacement. The price depends on the size of the damaged area, the pitch and height of your roof, and whether the decking needs work. Every job starts with a free inspection and a written estimate, so you know the exact price before we ever start.

Q: How fast can you get to a leaking roof?
A:
Active leaks go to the front of the line. In most of our Alabama service area we can come take a look within a day or two, and we'll walk you through protecting the inside of your home in the meantime.

Q: Will you try to sell me a whole new roof?
A:
No. If a repair will truly solve the problem, that's exactly what we recommend. It costs a fraction of a replacement and adds years to the roof you already have. We only bring up replacement when a repair no longer makes financial sense, and we show you the photos so you can see it for yourself.

Q: Is storm or hail damage a repair or an insurance claim?
A:
It depends on how far the damage goes. A few wind-lifted shingles are usually a simple repair. Widespread hail bruising usually means you have an insurance claim, and we handle that whole process for you, from the photos to working with your adjuster.

## Storm & Hail Damage Roof Repair in Alabama | Precision Roofing

URL: https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/storm-damage

Summary: Storm or hail just hit? Free storm damage roof inspections across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn/Opelika & Baldwin County. We document everything and handle your insurance claim. Call (334) 318-7255.

# Storm & Hail Damage Roof Repair in Alabama

Storm just rolled through? Get a free, honest damage inspection from local pros. And if you have a claim, we'll handle the insurance process for you, start to finish.

### After the Storm, Before the Leak

Alabama takes a beating: spring hail, summer thunderstorms, tropical remnants off the Gulf. Most storm damage can't be seen from the ground . Hail bruises shingles without tearing them, and wind lifts edges that let water creep in slowly for months.

Our crews inspect the whole roof system, from shingles and flashing to vents and gutters, and photograph everything . If the damage is minor, we repair it and you're done. If it's widespread, you likely have an insurance claim, and we handle that process for you .

Proudly serving Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn-Opelika, and Baldwin County . Licensed, insured, CertainTeed-certified, and 5.0-star rated by your neighbors.

Free Storm Inspection
(334) 318-7255

Warning Signs

### How to Tell Your Roof Took Damage

From the ground, look for: shingles in the yard or gutters, granules piling up at downspout exits, dented gutters or window screens, and dinged siding or AC fins. If hail hit those, it hit your roof too.

Up top (leave this to us): hail bruising (soft, dark spots where the granules got knocked away), creased or lifted shingles from wind, cracked pipe boots, and bent flashing. None of these leak on day one, but every one of them leaks eventually.

Inside the house: new ceiling stains, damp attic insulation, or daylight through the roof decking mean water is already getting in. Give us a call the same day at (334) 318-7255 .

Neighbors getting roofs replaced after a storm is itself a sign: hail doesn't skip houses. If out-of-town storm chasers are knocking on your door, get a second opinion from a local, licensed Alabama company that will still be here in five years.

How It Works

### From Storm to Restored, Step by Step

**Free Inspection**

We inspect and photograph the entire roof system, documenting every mark the storm left.

**Honest Verdict**

Minor damage? We quote a repair. Widespread damage? We walk you through the claim option.

We file the documentation and meet your adjuster on the roof so nothing gets missed. How claim help works .

Repair or full replacement to manufacturer spec. CertainTeed materials, our own crews, spotless cleanup.

FAQ

### Storm Damage Questions, Answered

Q: Does homeowners insurance cover hail damage in Alabama?
A:
In most cases, yes. Standard policies cover sudden storm damage, including hail and wind. What matters is documenting the damage properly and filing within your policy's time limits. We photograph everything, meet your adjuster on the roof, and make sure nothing gets missed.

Q: How soon after a storm should I get an inspection?
A:
As soon as possible. Damage isn't always visible from the ground, and small breaches let water in slowly. By the time a ceiling stain appears, there may be months of hidden damage. Most policies also have filing deadlines. The inspection is free, so there's no reason to wait.

Q: What does a storm damage inspection cost?
A:
Nothing. Our storm inspections are free, with no obligation. You get an honest assessment either way. If your roof is fine, we'll be glad to tell you so.

Q: Will my insurance rates go up if I file a roof claim?
A:
Storm damage is an "act of God" claim, which insurers treat differently than at-fault claims. Regional rates often adjust after major storms whether or not you file. We can't promise what your insurer will do, but we can make sure your claim is documented properly so you get what your policy owes you.

### Think the Storm Got Your Roof?

Don't wait for the ceiling stain. Get a free storm damage inspection and an honest answer. If you have a claim, we'll handle it from start to finish.

# Roof Insurance Claim Help in Alabama

Storm or hail damage? Precision Roofing Alabama works directly with your adjuster, documenting the damage and guiding you through the claim so you get the coverage you're owed.

### We Handle the Claim For You

Dealing with an insurance company after a storm is stressful and confusing. We take that weight off your shoulders, inspecting your roof, documenting every bit of damage, and working directly with your adjuster on your behalf.

Our team knows what carriers look for. We provide detailed photo documentation and a clear scope of work, then meet your adjuster on-site to make sure nothing legitimate gets missed or undervalued.

From the first inspection to the final installation, we keep the process smooth, fair, and stress-free for homeowners across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn-Opelika, and Baldwin County .

How It Works

### The Claim Process, Step by Step

**Free Damage Inspection**

We inspect the full roof system and photograph every mark the storm left, before you ever have to call your insurer.

**You File, We Support**

If the damage justifies a claim, you file with our documentation in hand. We're on the phone with you if you want us there.

**Adjuster Meeting**

We meet your adjuster on the roof, walk them through the damage, and make sure nothing gets missed or undervalued.

**Roof Restored**

Once approved, we complete the repair or replacement to manufacturer spec and hand you the photos and warranty.

Why It Works

### Documentation Wins Claims

Claims don't usually get underpaid because adjusters are unfair. They get underpaid because damage goes undocumented . Hail bruising that's invisible from the ground, wind-creased shingles that look fine until you lift them, flashing damage hidden behind gutters: if it isn't photographed and written into the scope, it doesn't get paid.

Our inspection produces a photo record of every slope, penetration, and accessory : roof, vents, flashing, gutters, screens, and siding, plus a written scope of work in the format carriers expect. That's what we bring to the adjuster meeting, and it's why our homeowners' claims so rarely come back short.

Not sure whether what you're seeing is claim-worthy? Start with our storm & hail damage guide or just give us a call at (334) 318-7255 . The inspection is free and the answer is honest either way.

FAQ

### Insurance Claim Questions, Answered

Q: What does your insurance claim help cost me?
A:
Nothing extra. The inspection and documentation are free, and our job is quoted to the insurance scope of work. You typically pay only your policy deductible. Your policy sets that, not us.

Q: Should I call my insurance company or a roofer first?
A:
Get the roof inspected first. If the damage doesn't justify a claim, you avoid filing one unnecessarily. If it does, you'll file with photo documentation already in hand, which makes the whole process smoother and harder to undervalue.

Q: What if my claim gets denied or lowballed?
A:
It happens, especially without good documentation. We provide detailed photos and a clear scope of work, meet the adjuster in person, and if something legitimate was missed we help you request a re-inspection with the evidence to back it up.

Q: How long do I have to file a storm damage claim in Alabama?
A:
Policies vary, but most give you a limited window, often one year from the storm date and sometimes less. Don't wait: damage gets harder to attribute to a specific storm as time passes. A free inspection now establishes the record.

### Storm Damage? Let's Talk.

Schedule your free roof inspection today. We'll document the damage and walk you through every step of the claim. No obligation, no pressure.

Schedule Free Inspection

## Roof Financing in Alabama | Flexible Payment Options | Precision Roofing

URL: https://www.precisionroofingalabama.com/financing

Summary: Flexible roofing financing across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn/Opelika & Baldwin County, AL: payment options for a range of budgets and a fast, simple approval process. Ask during your free estimate.

# Financing Options

At Precision Roofing Alabama, we believe every homeowner deserves a safe, protected home, without financial stress. That's why we offer flexible financing options to fit a range of budgets and credit situations.

Whether you're investing in a full roof replacement, a storm-damage repair, or a new metal roof, we have payment solutions designed to fit your budget, so protecting your home never has to wait.

Financing Available for a Range of Credit Types

Fast & Simple Approval Process

Competitive Monthly Payment Options

Ask us about current financing plans and terms during your free, no-obligation roof inspection and estimate.

How It Works

### How Roof Financing Works

**Free Inspection First**

Before anyone talks about money, we get up on your roof and look at the whole thing. You get photos of what we find and a straight answer about whether you need a repair or a replacement.

**A Written Estimate**

We put the scope and the price in writing. No surprise line items later, and no pressure to decide while we are standing in your driveway.

**Pick a Payment Plan**

If you would rather spread the cost out, we walk you through the plans available for your situation and what the monthly payment would actually look like.

**Approval and Scheduling**

Approval is usually quick. Once you are approved and you give us the go-ahead, we get you on the schedule and get your home protected.

Why It Matters

### Should You Finance a Roof in Alabama?

A roof is not the kind of purchase most folks get to plan for. A spring hail storm rolls through Montgomery or Birmingham, and all of a sudden you are looking at a job you did not budget for last month. Financing exists so a damaged roof does not have to sit and get worse while you save up.

Waiting is what costs people money. Water that gets past a few missing shingles does not stay in the attic. It finds decking, then insulation, then drywall, and a job that started as a roof repair turns into a full replacement plus interior work. Getting the roof handled on a monthly payment is almost always cheaper than getting it handled after the ceiling stains show up.

Financing is also worth a look when you are dealing with a claim. Your insurance may cover most of a storm or hail damage replacement, but you are still responsible for your deductible, and sometimes for upgrades your policy will not pay for. A payment plan can cover that gap so you are not out of pocket all at once. We explain exactly where your claim stops and your responsibility starts when we go over your insurance claim .

And to be plain with you: financing is an option, not a requirement, and it is not right for everybody. If paying outright makes more sense for your family, we will tell you so. We would rather earn your trust and your neighbor's referral than push a payment plan you did not need.

FAQ

### Roof Financing Questions, Answered

Q: Do you offer financing for a new roof in Alabama?
A:
Yes. Precision Roofing Alabama offers flexible financing on roof replacements, roof repairs, and storm damage work for homeowners across Montgomery, Birmingham, Huntsville, Auburn, Opelika, and Baldwin County. We go over the plans available to you during your free estimate, so you can see the monthly number before you commit to anything.

Q: What credit score do I need to qualify?
A:
There is no single cutoff. We work with financing options built for a range of credit situations, so a less than perfect score does not automatically rule you out. The honest answer is that terms depend on the lender and on your situation, which is why we run through it with you directly instead of quoting numbers on a web page.

Q: How long does approval take?
A:
The application is short and approval is typically fast, often the same day. For an active leak or storm damage, that speed matters, because it means we can get you on the schedule before the next round of Alabama weather comes through.

Q: Can I finance just my insurance deductible?
A:
That is one of the most common reasons homeowners ask us about payment plans. When insurance covers the bulk of a storm damage replacement, financing can cover the deductible and any upgrades your policy will not pay for, so you are not writing one large check. We will show you exactly what your claim covers before you decide.

Q: Does financing cost me anything to ask about?
A:
Not a thing. The roof inspection is free, the written estimate is free, and walking through your payment options is part of that same visit. There is no obligation and no pressure. If you decide to pay outright or to hold off entirely, that is perfectly fine by us.

Q: Do you offer financing on repairs, or only full replacements?
A:
Both. Plenty of folks assume payment plans are only for a full tear-off, but a larger repair can qualify too. If a repair will genuinely solve your problem, that is what we are going to recommend, and we would rather help you finance the right job than sell you a bigger one.

### Ready to Get Started?

Schedule your free roof inspection today and ask about financing. No obligation, no pressure, just an honest assessment from a team you can trust.

We install for those conditions: correct nailing patterns and fastener counts, sealed edges and starter strips, upgraded underlayment, and CertainTeed systems rated for high wind. What To Expect

### What Happens After You Reach Out

**We Call You Back**

A real person from our team gets back to you within one business day, and usually a good bit sooner. If you have water coming in, call us directly and we will move you to the front of the line.

**Free Roof Inspection**

We come out at a time that works for you and look over the entire roof, not just the spot that is bothering you. Every finding gets photographed so you can see what we see.

**Honest Recommendation**

You get a written estimate and a straight answer. If a repair will fix it, we say so. If it is time for a replacement, we show you why with the photos in hand.

**You Decide, Not Us**

No high pressure close, no today-only pricing. Take the estimate, sit with it, get another quote if you want one. We will be here when you are ready.

Get In Touch

### The Best Way To Reach Us

If your roof is actively leaking, please call us at (334) 318-7255 rather than filling out the form. A phone call gets a crew looking at your situation the same day, and we can walk you through protecting the inside of your home while you wait on us.

For everything else, the form on this page works beautifully. Tell us your address, what you are seeing, and whether a storm came through recently. The more detail you give us up front, the more useful our first phone call is going to be. You can also email us any time at contact.precisionral@gmail.com , and photos are always welcome.

We answer Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM, and we take Sunday appointments when a homeowner needs one. Precision Roofing Alabama is a licensed and insured Alabama home builder, HB # 41012, and a CertainTeed certified contractor.

Service Area

### Where We Work

We serve homeowners across the State of Alabama, with crews working regularly in Montgomery , Birmingham , Huntsville , Auburn and Opelika , and Baldwin County . If your town is not on that list, reach out anyway. Odds are good we already work near you, and you can see the full map on our service area page .

Not sure what you need yet? That is exactly what a free inspection is for. Most folks call us about a roof repair or a roof replacement , but a fair number call right after a storm and end up needing storm and hail damage work and help with an insurance claim . We handle all of it, and we will tell you which one you are actually dealing with.

FAQ

### Before You Call, A Few Common Questions

Q: How fast will someone get back to me?
A:
Within one business day for form submissions and emails, and usually the same day. Active leaks and storm damage go to the front of the line, so call (334) 318-7255 directly if water is getting into your home right now.

Q: Is the roof inspection really free?
A:
Yes, completely free and with no obligation. We inspect the roof, photograph what we find, and hand you a written estimate. There is no charge whether you hire us or not, and no one is going to call you six times afterward.

Q: What information should I have ready?
A:
Your address, roughly how old the roof is if you know, what you are seeing inside or outside the house, and whether a recent storm came through. If you have already filed an insurance claim, have your claim number handy. None of this is required, it just helps us help you faster.

Q: Do you charge for an estimate after a storm?
A:
No. Post-storm inspections are free, including the photo documentation you would need for a claim. We will tell you honestly whether you have enough damage to be worth filing on, because a claim that gets denied helps nobody.

Q: Are you licensed and insured in Alabama?
A:
We are. Precision Roofing Alabama LLC carries Alabama Home Builder license HB # 41012 and full liability and workers compensation coverage, and we are a CertainTeed certified contractor. We are glad to provide proof of insurance before any work begins.
